question: Can the released logFC-ranked NK enrichment family, leading edges and selected curves be reconstructed with the pinned gene-set package?
decision: Separate exact deterministic enrichment-score and membership concordance from stochastic NES/P discrepancies; support only transcript-set association.
strongest_rival: Different source versions or mistaken biological units could make a visually similar reconstruction appear faithful.
discriminator: Replay all Hallmark and C2 CP:KEGG pathways from msigdbr 7.5.1, compare all source rows and leading edges, and independently reconstruct weighted running-sum scores in NumPy.
exposure_record: Published enrichment outcomes and source scripts/exports are exposed. Local S1 and S3 block diagnostics are known; no local enrichment output calculated before this contract.
biological_unit: Sorted pooled NK preparation/library; reported experimental replicate is a block.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine named libraries; constituent animal IDs, exact pool sizes and cross-assay animal reuse remain unknown. Replicate denotes experiment/day, not repeated mouse.
population_and_selection: All released NK input libraries and features from GSE287581 and pinned author commit 61ac9a440ba3f9db754ff8b8ad5008b450e647c0.
contrast: Source/sample qualification for ITDT minus PBS and ITDT+aCD4 minus ITDT, with the released third contrast retained for later replay.
endpoint: Enrichment score, normalized score, source Monte Carlo P, within-family BH adjustment, leading-edge genes and pathway coverage.
methods: fgsea 1.26.0; msigdbr 7.5.1 and babelgene 22.9; uppercase gene identifiers; AveExpr>1; descending logFC; seed42 per contrast; gseaParam1, scoreType std, minSize0, maxSizeInf, nPermSimple3000. SerialParam explicitly replaces an undocumented source backend. CLI_NO_THREAD=true disables a progress-display thread to avoid Windows ARM shutdown failure, without changing numerical algorithms. ES independent and source comparisons use absolute1e-8; report every stochastic NES/P/log2err difference with no invented agreement threshold.
missingness_and_exclusions: Source AveExpr filter only; reject duplicate uppercase symbols; unique pathway/gene memberships as released; report missing/excess pathways and full coverage.
multiplicity: Preserve fgsea BH adjustment over the complete tested Hallmark+KEGG family for each contrast; the three displayed pathways are source-selected and exposed.
precision_basis: Only three reported blocks and unknown animal membership; source-model P values are reproduced but no new population precision or biological power claim.
interpretation_limit: Reproduction of exposed pooled-library TPM transcript differences; not independent replication, count-based voom reconstruction, NK killing, secretion, signaling or mediation.
stop_rule: Fail API/runtime, duplicate IDs or independent ES checks. Preserve any source pathway/ES/leading-edge discrepancy. No newer gene-set replacement or significance-selected display.
amendment_reason: Initial enrichment replay after S1 all-field concordance and successful pinned package/API exit with documented CLI progress-thread workaround.
